page.title: Landing
page.value: Understand your genetic result - in your language, at your pace, with a counsellor one tap away.

hero.title: Understand your genes. Empower your future.
hero.body: Genetic information shouldn't be complicated. Understand screening results, explore inherited health risks and connect with qualified professionals — with privacy and informed choice at every step.
hero.trust: Knowledge without judgement. Guidance without pressure.
hero.imageAlt: Abstract fluorescent microscopy in teal and violet. Decorative only. Not a personal result.

problem.heading: What this is for
problem.intro: Screening can leave people with paperwork, questions, and uncertainty. Rafeeq is built to slow that moment down.

one.title: Complex genetic information
one.body: Results often arrive in technical language. We explain them in plain words, without stigma.

two.title: Questions after screening
two.body: A report is not the end of the conversation. You can learn, check understanding, and ask for a human when it matters.

three.title: Privacy and informed decisions
three.body: You decide what is shared, with whom, and when. Nothing here assumes a marriage or family choice.

plain.title: Plain language
plain.body: Explains a result in plain, non-stigmatizing language.

sharing.title: You control sharing
sharing.body: Each partner controls what is shared with the other and with the clinic.

humans.title: Humans for the big questions
humans.body: Complex, ambiguous, or high-impact cases go to a human genetics professional. It never replaces a counsellor.

one.title: Understand
one.body: Learn what screening results mean, in your language, at your pace.

two.title: Explore
two.body: Understand inherited risk and uncertainty without treating a chance as a prediction.

three.title: Connect
three.body: Find qualified counselling and support when questions are complex or high-impact.

four.title: Stay in control
four.body: Manage consent and information sharing. You can change what is shared.

approach.heading: Our approach
approach.body: Rafeeq supports informed decisions without judgement, pressure, or assumptions about marriage and family choices. It is education and navigation. It never diagnoses, and it never decides for you.
approach.imageAlt: A quiet table and chair in a bright room. A calm place for a conversation.

science.heading: Grounded in careful explanation
science.body: Laboratory science is the starting point. What you see here is explanation and support, not a diagnosis or a substitute for a qualified professional.
science.imageAlt: A genetics laboratory with sequencing equipment. Contextual only. Not a personal test site.

privacySection.heading: Privacy and trust
privacySection.intro: Sharing is consent-led. Complex questions go to a person. This preview uses synthetic fixtures, not real genomes.
privacySection.consent: Consent-led sharing: each person controls what is visible to a partner or clinic.
privacySection.respect: Respect for individual privacy: your own result stays available to you.
privacySection.uncertainty: Clear explanations of uncertainty: a chance is not a prediction about any child.
privacySection.human: Human counselling for complex questions. The product does not replace a counsellor.

cta.heading: Start when you are ready
cta.body: Enter the guest demo to see how Rafeeq explains a synthetic result. There is no pressure to continue.

trust.title: Trust centre
trust.synthetic: All data is synthetic. No real person, genome, or Emirati Genome Programme data.
trust.frequencies: Carrier frequencies are marked illustrative until replaced by cited values.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.own: A couple member sees their own result always.
privacy.overlap: A partner's data is visible only for the overlap (genes both people carry), and only if both granted that sharing.
privacy.clinic: A clinic sees only what the user shares.
privacy.counsellor: A counsellor sees the brief and shared fields, and never sees raw results unless they are shared.
privacy.analyst: An analyst sees aggregates only (k-anonymity of at least 5), with no row-level data.
privacy.audit: Every access to results, shares, and consents is written to an audit log.
privacy.revoke: Consent revocation takes effect immediately and is shown to the user.
privacy.guest: Guest sessions are deleted after 24 hours.

ai.heading: How AI is used and limited
ai.role: This is education, decision support, and navigation. It never diagnoses, never recommends a reproductive decision, and never replaces a counsellor.
ai.inputs: The language model never sees genotypes, names, IDs, or free-text identifiers. It receives only a pre-built, de-identified fact-card ID list and the question text after PII scrubbing.
ai.limits: The language model does not write new medical content. It may classify intent, select an approved content block, or lightly rephrase an approved block at a stated reading level. Output must pass the verifier, or a fixed fallback is shown.
ai.human: Hard routes bypass the language model and go to a human.
ai.routes: Distress or self-harm language. Pregnancy termination questions. Religious rulings. Requests about another person's results. Blame. Diagnosis requests. Medication or treatment advice. Requests to decide for the user, including whether to marry. Legal or immigration questions. Minors.

review.heading: Who reviews content
review.status: Clinical-facing text lives in the content files, in Arabic and English, with a status of draft or clinician-reviewed.
review.draft: Draft blocks display this notice: prototype content - not clinically validated.
review.arabic: Arabic copy must be reviewed by a native speaker on the team and, ideally, an Emirati counsellor.

legal.title: Legal
legal.intro: This page describes how this preview talks about privacy, consent, and medical limits. It is not a contract.

legal.synthetic: The guest demo uses synthetic fixtures. It does not use real personal genomes.
